ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.
   D. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   D. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)

   B. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.

13. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

15. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   C. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
